reference_allele_note: ABO is on the minus strand of chr9. The GRCh38 reference-allele identity at the O-defining frameshift (rs8176719) determines whether a homozygous-reference sample types as A/B (reference carries the intact base) or O (reference already carries the deletion) — this MUST be confirmed with `samtools faidx` before the O logic is trusted. Empirical faidx context recorded below at the widely-cited positions; positions themselves still require dbSNP/Ensembl confirmation.
